description: This file contains the implementation of the 'Cron' class within the OpenCart system, specifically in the namespace 'Opencart.Catalog.Model.Setting'. The class provides methods to manage cron jobs, such as editing cron entries, updating status, retrieving specific cron data by ID or code, getting a list of crons, and counting total crons.

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: A model class in the OpenCart system responsible for managing scheduled cron jobs, including their retrieval, updating, and counting.

methods.name: editCron
methods.description: Updates the 'date_modified' timestamp for a specific cron entry identified by its ID.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of a specific cron entry to active or inactive using its ID.

methods.name: getCron
methods.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific cron entry by its ID.

methods.name: getCronByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a cron entry based on its unique code.

methods.name: getCrons
methods.description: Returns a list of all cron entries, ordered by modification date.

methods.name: getTotalCrons
methods.description: Returns the total number of cron entries stored in the database.
